correctness.rationale: The four-mode tridiagonal H with couplings a,b,a and imaginary gain/loss ±iγ at opposite end sites has characteristic polynomial λ⁴+(γ²−2a²−b²)λ²+a⁴−b²γ². Setting t=a²/b² and x=γ²/b² yields quadratic P(u)=u²−(2t+1−x)u+t²−x, discriminant (x−(2t−1))²+4t(2−t). For t>2, discriminant negative on (x−,x+); positive u roots reappear above x+ iff sqrt(t(t−2))<1, i.e. 2<t<1+sqrt2, until x=t². The exact positive recovered width is W=b[t−sqrt(x+)]. Algebraic identity t²−x+=(1−q)² shows W/J=[(1−q)²]/[(t+sqrt(x+))(2sqrt t+1)] strictly decreases with t, so supremum is nonattained (2−sqrt3)/(2sqrt2+1), as t↓2. Nonzero nearest-neighbor links force eigenspace dimensions one at repeated roots; at upper endpoint a single order-four exceptional point occurs. Independent symbolic characteristic polynomial and positive/negative phase samples corroborated proof.
